subject.title: build(deps-dev): bump vite from 8.0.16 to 8.1.4 in the development group across 1 directory

question: Should this repository accept the Vite 8.1.4 lockfile graph containing `@emnapi/runtime@1.11.1` despite Socket’s obfuscated-code warning?
rationale: The patch and automated validation are clean, but accepting or deferring a flagged executable build dependency is a supply-chain risk decision that CI cannot resolve.

options.title: Verify package, then merge
options.body: Inspect the package source and provenance, confirm the flagged content is expected generated/WASM tooling, and merge if acceptable.

options.title: Defer the update
options.body: Leave the PR open or close it until a later Vite graph avoids the warning or stronger upstream evidence becomes available.

options.title: Explicitly accept the warning
options.body: Merge after documenting that maintainers knowingly accept the scanner signal without additional package inspection.

recommendation.title: Verify package, then merge
recommendation.body: Inspect the package source and provenance, confirm the flagged content is expected generated/WASM tooling, and merge if acceptable.
